leakage_audit.variant_b_verdict: INVALID — variant B contains only positives + easy negatives, and L8 evaluates on neg_type != 'easy', so its decision set is positives only. Its F0.5 exactly equals the oracle ceiling (0.9023), confirming it measures candidate recall, not the matcher.
leakage_audit.guard_added: main_l8.py now flags variants with no hard negatives in the decision set as 'comparable: false' and excludes them from winner selection.

confidence_remaining_gap.interpretation: Candidate recall is the binding constraint; the matcher retains ~89% of what perfect classification within candidates would score.

decision: Variant A (hard negatives) is the valid system; Variant B discarded.
